material_updates_additions.status: Qualitative company evidence reviewed. Access terms and catalogue rights vary by territory. These markets already offered Audiobooks in Premium.
material_updates_additions.quantitative_status: No listener, borrower, subscriber, revenue or national observation added. The release gives an overall title catalogue count without a country breakdown or counting definition.
